decisions.reason: A catalog CD in a warehouse-backed shop costs little to keep listed, and niche schlager demand from collectors keeps producing occasional sales, so the option is still worth holding.
The illustrated series is a multi-model line that strengthens the label's curated identity, and further volumes can be added at low incremental cost, so keeping the option open is attractive.
Reissued jazz vinyl fits the firm's push to broaden genres and formats, and stock costs little to hold, although a limited pressing could sell out and leave the market.
Premium box sets are core to the firm's collector positioning and sell slowly over years at low carrying cost, though limited runs may eventually be exhausted.
The compilation CD received only a mention and has weaker visible support, but delisting saves almost nothing in a long-tail catalog, so the firm would likely keep it available.
